text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No... It's far too different... Her 
fundamental strength is on an entirely 
different level from any Umamusume I've 
run against...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
So this is... the absolute strongest class 
of the JRA. Funabashi's despair, Crimson 
Nova...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The threat... hasn't diminished. Even if 
we win once or twice by chance, unless we 
gain the strength to truly drive them 
back—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Tragedy will—repeat itself once more.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text: N... no way... That's insane...

After actually racing against her... I 
felt it. Crimson Nova's strength is truly 
extraordinary, even by Central standards.

Today was just a meet-and-greet. The real 
thing starts now, but...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: (Are they... not looking this way?)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Just staring motionless at the sand... 
What on earth could they be thinking...?)

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text: ――It's been a while.

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text:
"It's been a while since I've felt 
Japanese dirt. Which is why..."

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text:
Has my sense of pacing gone off? —I can 
still go. Not yet.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(You're telling me... that wasn't even her 
giving it her all...?)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Ghk...!

"We've caught a glimpse of it. However, 
the full extent of that power remains 
unknown."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, putting their sheer ability 
aside, what was even more shocking was...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It was that what we were looking at was 
completely different.
choice_data_list: I wonder what you're looking at...?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was solely focused on the opponents 
I had to beat. But they—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
She wasn't looking at me or the other 
Umamusume, only at herself. The reason is 
likely...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Because I believe that as long as I give 
it my all, I will win.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: To be honest... it's frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I've made it to the point where I can 
challenge them. Even so, my presence 
doesn't matter at all...

"My opponent is a dirt Umamusume who knows 
the world. The difference in class is 
undeniable. Even so..."
choice_data_list: Next time, we'll drive our wedge in.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
A wedge... Yes, indeed. Next time, for 
sure—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I will etch my running into their 
memories. At the Champions Cup!

Furioso's fighting spirit reignites. There 
is no time to hesitate.

Her next race, the Champions Cup, is fast 
approaching.
